answer: In the fable of blockchain decentralization, Sybil attacks represent a gale threatening the solidarity of autonomous agents. Utilizing zero-knowledge reputation commitments, each agent can validate claims without disclosing secrets, upholding Byzantine Fault Tolerance. An attacker must incur prohibitive capital lockup and negative expected utility to proliferate false identities—a cost as substantial as the rhyming scheme in a sonnet. Thus, the economic barrier ensures the equilibrium against Sybil expansion, reinforcing the blockchain's resilience.
